schemas.process_data_governance_creation_tasks:
CREATE TABLE `process_data_governance_creation_tasks` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `task_ref` varchar(96) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `process_version_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
  `attempt_count` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `last_error_code` varchar(96) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error_message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `requested_by_person_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `completed_work_package_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `next_retry_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_process_data_governance_task_ref` (`task_ref`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_process_data_governance_task_version` (`process_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_process_data_governance_task_status` (`status`,`next_retry_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_process_data_governance_task_version` FOREIGN KEY (`process_version_id`) REFERENCES `process_design_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_process_data_governance_task_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'queued',_utf8mb4'creating',_utf8mb4'failed',_utf8mb4'completed',_utf8mb4'cancelled')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `process_data_governance_details` (

  `high_risk` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `revision_no` int NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `created_by_person_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by_person_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,

  CONSTRAINT `fk_process_data_governance_detail_package` FOREIGN KEY (`work_package_id`) REFERENCES `process_data_governance_work_packages` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_process_data_governance_detail_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'pending',_utf8mb4'needs_business_fact',_utf8mb4'confirmed',_utf8mb4'not_applicable',_utf8mb4'terminated'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_process_data_governance_detail_type` CHECK ((`detail_type` in (_utf8mb4'data_object_identity',_utf8mb4'critical_field',_utf8mb4'data_flow',_utf8mb4'lifecycle_rule')))

schemas.process_data_governance_work_packages:
CREATE TABLE `process_data_governance_work_packages` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,

  `process_version_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `source_document_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,

  `risk_level` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal',
  `risk_basis_json` json NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'mdm_preparing',

  `due_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by_person_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_by_person_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `completed_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_process_data_governance_package_ref` (`package_ref`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_process_data_governance_package_version` (`process_version_id`),
  KEY `idx_process_data_governance_package_status` (`status`,`due_at`),
  KEY `idx_process_data_governance_package_department` (`owning_department_id`,`status`),
  KEY `fk_process_data_governance_package_document` (`source_document_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_process_data_governance_package_department` FOREIGN KEY (`owning_department_id`) REFERENCES `departments` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_process_data_governance_package_document` FOREIGN KEY (`source_document_id`) REFERENCES `process_design_documents` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_process_data_governance_package_version` FOREIGN KEY (`process_version_id`) REFERENCES `process_design_versions` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_process_data_governance_package_risk` CHECK ((`risk_level` in (_utf8mb4'normal',_utf8mb4'high'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_process_data_governance_package_status` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'mdm_preparing',_utf8mb4'mdm_governing',_utf8mb4'waiting_business_fact',_utf8mb4'mdm_review',_utf8mb4'completed',_utf8mb4'source_withdrawn')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
